description: This Java source file defines the OrderByItem class, which implements comparison logic and SQL string generation for ordering entities in database queries within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: OrderByItem
classes.description: A class that represents an ordering criterion for database query results, supporting comparison, SQL string generation, and parsing from string representations.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the EntityConditionValue used for ordering.

methods.name: getDescending
methods.description: Indicates whether the order is descending.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses an object (String, EntityConditionValue, or OrderByItem) into an OrderByItem instance.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a string to create an OrderByItem, handling nulls first/last, ascending/descending, and case sensitivity.

methods.name: checkOrderBy
methods.description: Validates the order by value against a model entity.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares two GenericEntity objects based on the order by value, considering nulls and order direction.

methods.name: makeOrderByString
methods.description: Generates an SQL order by clause string for this order by item.

methods.name: makeOrderByString
methods.description: Appends an SQL order by clause string to a StringBuilder.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code for the OrderByItem.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on value and order direction.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the OrderByItem, including order direction and nulls handling.
